verdict.rationale: Limitless is a wearable pendant and lifelog service with an API and MCP server for searching recorded audio and transcripts. It does not operate or click on user interfaces, so documenting how it locates UI elements (accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, coordinates) to debug misclicks is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any screen-perception or UI-automation capability.
